section_1.title: Mature student guide
section_1.description: A simple guide for adults returning to education, changing career or studying while working.

section_2.title: What students usually need to know.
section_2.description: Clear, useful guidance designed for mature students who want a realistic route into university.

cards.title: You do not need to be 18
cards.description: Many UK degree routes are built for adults with work and family commitments.

cards.title: Funding may be available
cards.description: Tuition Fee Loan, Maintenance Loan and some grants can support eligible students.

cards.title: Choose the right route
cards.description: Foundation years, CertHE, HNDs and full degrees can all lead to progression.

cards.title: Prepare documents early
cards.description: ID, share code, certificates, CV and address history are commonly needed.

cards.title: Flexible study matters
cards.description: Look for blended, evening, weekend or online learning patterns.

cards.title: Get guidance
cards.description: A good adviser helps you avoid courses that do not fit your goals.

section_3.title: Turn this guide into a plan.
section_3.description: We can help you compare routes, understand funding and prepare your application documents.
section_3.ctaDescription: Start with eligibility, then speak to an adviser if you want human support.
